enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Shift legs. Turn to back. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket. Breathe deeply. Remain still.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open shower curtain. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Grab towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil and eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Toast bread. Spread butter. Pour milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Open phone. Check messages. Put phone in pocket. Board bus. Tap transit card. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Greet colleagues. Start work.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Update records. Attend meeting. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Clean equipment. Wash hands. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Check messages. Respond to emails. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Take off shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to living room.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear table. Wash dishes. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Flip channels. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse internet. Check social media. Watch video. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn on water. Step into shower. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Grab towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm. Shift legs. Turn to back. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Remain still.
